references.text: Forbidden to have sexual relations with one's father's wife, which uncovers the father's nakedness
The penalty for lying with one's father's wife - both shall die; they have uncovered the father's nakedness
A man must not take his father's wife and must not uncover his father's skirt hem
Reuben lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine - an example of this sin
Jacob curses Reuben because he mounted his father's bed
Paul condemns a man in Corinth who had his father's wife
Context for the curses pronounced on Mount Ebal
